title: Granite State Whale Watch

services.name: Whale Watch
services.desc: Since all whale watchers are ‘guests’ visiting the natural environment of these animals, we consider every whale watch a true expedition. Thus, your whale watch boarding pass is not an admission to a show, but rather an opportunity to observe wild animals which, on a world-wide basis, are quite rare. Whether we sight these marvelous creatures is entirely up to the whales; the probability is quite excellent - we have a 99% sighting record. On the rare occasion that we do not sight any whales or dolphins, a free pass for a future trip will be issued.
